svg.title: ASPIRE: amplicon analysis workflow
svg.desc: Numbered conceptual modules use the MetaPathways nodal style. Shared read processing and full taxonomy precede control decontamination and final feature filtering. Diversity keeps the full biological cohort; selected groups feed other analyses. Module numbers are not a serial execution schedule.

text.tspan: Mamba environments • Resource controls • Resumable execution • Audited outputs
Paired amplicon reads, sample manifest, metadata and references
Configured biological / TECH / BIO sample classes
Optional: VOC measurements and genome references
Numbered modules group related operations; arrows summarize flow and enabled branches follow their dependencies.
